claims.claimText: Official FastH3-Omni 8-Step V1 BF16 weights card published on Hugging Face with reference conditioning and 8 transformer evaluation steps.
claims.basis: Observed during planning at the immutable revision; a copy of the README was not captured, so no evidence digest exists yet.

claims.claimText: Official FastH3-Omni Comfy pruned INT8 checkpoint published with published LFS SHA-256 and size ~22.2GB.
FastVideo source repository contains basic_fasth3_omniref_rtx4090.yaml recipe configured for 832x480 124 frames with layerwise FP8 streaming (16 blocks) and BF16 VSA emulator.
claims.basis: Observed at commit 7203b4976eefcd70a52728ca1281797ce96734eb during planning; the recipe file was not captured or hashed, so it cannot yet be copied into a compiled specification.

claims.claimText: Reactor hosted API advertises discrete durations 5.875, 8, 10.125, 12.25, 14.375s and up to 3/9 reference images; hosted only, private assets prohibited from upload.
claims.basis: Stated in the issue snapshot of 2026-10-19 and the design; mutable hosted documentation, not captured as a dated copy.

claims.claimText: Base MiniMax-H3 community license excludes EU/UK/KR/US territories, imposes $20M revenue conditions, and restricts output redistribution; commercial approval is review_required.
claims.basis: MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3 LICENSE file inspected at commit 42ed227ee7df40d41602854ae760620d6eb651fe.

claims.claimText: Accelerated NVFP4 text encoding requires NVIDIA Blackwell hardware per the Comfy card and is not usable on RTX 4090 (SM89).
claims.basis: FastH3-Omni-Comfy README explicitly warns that NVFP4 text encoding requires Blackwell hardware.

claims.claimText: FastVideo FP8/dense export shards, shard index, runtime config, tokenizer/processor, encoder, VAEs and AdaLN table (names, sizes, SHA-256) are not enumerated.
claims.basis: Not audited. Recorded as unknown; unknown denies the corresponding operation.

claims.claimText: Python, PyTorch/CUDA build, driver, kernel and dependency lock for the SM89 lane are not resolved; the pinned ComfyUI environment is not evidence for them.
claims.basis: Not audited. Recorded as unknown; unknown denies the corresponding operation.

claims.claimText: The upstream launch command and recipe schema for the Ref2VA lane are not captured, so no argv or config is compiled.
claims.basis: Not audited. Recorded as unknown; unknown denies the corresponding operation.

rejectedCandidates.name: fastvideo_fasth3_8step_v2_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors
rejectedCandidates.reason: FastH3 V2 checkpoint is strictly frame-anchored I2V only; lacks multi-reference conditioning architecture.

rejectedCandidates.name: minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors
rejectedCandidates.reason: FL2VA checkpoint is I2V first/last frame only; cannot accept general reference conditioning.

rejectedCandidates.name: experimental_omniref_pdd
rejectedCandidates.reason: Pre-release experimental PDD checkpoints lack official release lineage and stability guarantees.
